items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: he was one of them, he was a really good musician. He used to play tenor, played clarinet, I think he played a little piano.

ctx.x: What about Morris French? Did you know him, a trombone player? Morris French? No. He's up around La Posse now, I thought they knew him. What's his name? Morris French. No. He used to work with Louis and Papa Salas. Morris French? No, I don't know him. That's the word before you put about some of your brothers, because most people, you're the famous one, and probably some of your brothers were pretty good too.
Yeah, well I have Mount Woolley's brother, Robert, he was, he was one of them, he was a really good musician. He used to play tenor, played clarinet, I think he played a little piano.
He can do something with a bass, a little trombone, he can do a little everything.
